# Boardgame Together developer documentation

> Public developer documentation for humans and coding agents. Business API authorization remains enforced. SDK workspace version: 0.1.0. Administrator online installation supports boardgame-package-v1 ZIPs; arbitrary source repositories are not directly installable.
